notes: Group reputation. Each group (Angels of Delusion, Cunning Hares, Public Security, Obol Squad, Krampus, Yunkui Summit, Phaethon, the Sunbringers) has its own view of you, from hostile to one of their own. It's separate from each person's trust, members who barely know you go by it, and word travels inside a group. Helping or embarrassing a group, or keeping or breaking its rules, moves it. See it in 🧰 Tools → 🏛 Groups.
